prompt_content:
You are an expert radiologist.

Look at this chest X-ray. Is it Normal or Pneumonia? A separate four-class image classifier suggests {hint_label} when comparing Normal and Pneumonia. Its score for that label is {hint_score:.4f}. This is an uncalibrated model score, not a probability of disease. The suggestion may be wrong. Use the image to make your final decision. Answer with exactly Normal or Pneumonia and nothing else.
